dishes.name: Wholemeal egg and tomato toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Sauté onion and tomato in oil until softened.
Scramble the eggs and season lightly.
Serve the eggs and tomato mixture on toast.

dishes.name: Chicken brown rice bowl
steps: Cook the brown rice.
Marinate and pan-cook the chicken with garlic, ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Slice cucumber and carrot.
Serve chicken over rice with the sliced vegetables on the side.

dishes.name: Steamed bok choy with garlic
steps: Trim and wash the bok choy.
Steam or blanch until just tender.
Warm garlic in a little oil, then drizzle over the bok choy with soy sauce.

dishes.name: Tofu mushroom stir-fry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Press and cube the tofu, then pan-fry until lightly golden.
Stir-fry garlic, mushrooms, broccoli, and carrot.
Add tofu and soy sauce, toss, and serve with rice.

dishes.name: Garlic spinach
steps: Rinse the spinach well.
Sauté garlic in oil briefly.
Add spinach and cook just until wilted; season lightly.

dishes.name: Banana peanut butter oatmeal
steps: Simmer oats with milk until creamy.
Slice bananas.
Stir in peanut butter and cinnamon, then top with banana slices.

dishes.name: Turkey lettuce wraps
steps: Cook onion and garlic, then brown the turkey mince.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil.
Serve the filling in lettuce leaves with shredded carrot and spring onion.

dishes.name: Cucumber and sesame salad
steps: Slice the cucumber thinly.
Mix vinegar, soy sauce, and sugar.
Toss cucumber with dressing and sesame seeds.

dishes.name: Baked salmon with lemon rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Season salmon with garlic, lemon, oil, salt, and pepper.
Bake until the salmon is just cooked through.
Serve with lemon rice on the side.

dishes.name: Roasted zucchini
steps: Slice zucchini into spears.
Toss with oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast until browned and tender.

dishes.name: Greek yogurt with berries and granola
steps: Divide yogurt into bowls.
Top with berries and granola.
Drizzle with honey.

dishes.name: Beef and vegetable noodle soup
steps: Bring broth, garlic, and ginger to a simmer.
Cook the beef briefly in the broth.
Add noodles, carrot, and pak choy until tender.
Serve hot.

dishes.name: Pickled radish side
steps: Slice the radish thinly.
Mix with vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Chill before serving.

dishes.name: Chicken satay-style rice plate
steps: Cook the rice.
Marinate chicken with garlic, curry powder, soy sauce, and peanut butter.
Pan-cook or grill the chicken until done.
Serve with rice and cucumber slices.

dishes.name: Stir-fried kailan
steps: Wash and trim the kailan.
Stir-fry garlic, then add kailan and a little water.
Finish with oyster sauce and cook until bright green.

dishes.name: Wholemeal avocado egg sandwich
steps: Hard-boil or fry the eggs.
Mash avocado with a little salt and pepper.
Assemble with sliced tomato between toasted bread.

dishes.name: Shrimp fried rice
steps: Cook rice and let it cool slightly.
Scramble the egg and set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, shrimp, carrot, and peas, then add rice and soy sauce.
Fold in egg and serve hot.

dishes.name: Sautéed bean sprouts
steps: Quickly rinse the bean sprouts.
Sauté garlic in oil, add sprouts, and cook briefly.
Season lightly and serve immediately.

dishes.name: Tofu and eggplant curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Sauté onion and garlic, then add curry powder.
Add eggplant, tofu, and coconut milk, simmer until tender.
Serve hot with rice.

dishes.name: Steamed green beans
steps: Steam the green beans until tender-crisp.
Season with salt and a little sesame oil.

dishes.name: Cinnamon apple porridge
steps: Cook oats with milk until thick.
Dice the apple.
Top porridge with apple, raisins, and cinnamon.

dishes.name: Chicken and corn soup with barley
steps: Simmer broth with barley, onion, garlic, and carrot.
Add chicken and cook until done.

dishes.name: Tomato and herb salad
steps: Chop tomatoes and cucumber.
Toss with parsley, olive oil, and lemon juice.
Serve chilled.

dishes.name: Black pepper beef with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir-fry garlic and onion, then sear the beef.
Add bell pepper, black pepper, and soy sauce; toss until glossy.
Serve with rice.

dishes.name: Garlic roasted cauliflower
steps: Cut cauliflower into florets.
Toss with garlic, oil, and salt.
Roast until browned and tender.

dishes.name: Muesli with milk and sliced pear
steps: Divide muesli into bowls.
Add milk and sliced pear.
Serve immediately.

dishes.name: Chicken soba salad
steps: Cook the soba and cool them.
Cook chicken and slice it thinly.
Toss noodles with vegetables and dressing, then top with chicken.

dishes.name: Edamame side salad
steps: Cook and cool the edamame.
Mix with cucumber, vinegar, and sesame seeds.
Serve chilled.

dishes.name: Miso cod with rice
steps: Mix miso, soy sauce, mirin, and ginger.
Marinate the cod briefly.
Bake or pan-cook until the fish flakes easily and serve with rice.

dishes.name: Stir-fried asparagus
steps: Trim the asparagus.
Stir-fry quickly with garlic and oil.
Season lightly and serve while crisp.
